highlights.headline: Finland: Google announces €13 billion AI, energy investment
highlights.summary: Google has announced a plan to expand AI data centers and buy massive amounts of nuclear energy. Finland's security services have warned of there are risks, but the right-wing government says the deal will bring jobs.

highlights.headline: Commission sets out next chapter for European Capitals of Culture after over 40 years of success
highlights.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 10 Sep 2026 Today, the European Commission renews and strengthens the framework for the European Capitals of Culture beyond 2033, applying the lessons of more than 40 years of experience into the programme's next generation.

items.title: Are electric vehicles really bad for the environment?
items.description: Some German politicians are calling for a delay to the EU plan to phase out gas-powered vehicles, saying cars must be judged on the entire carbon footprint. But the full picture still says EVs are more climate friendly.

items.title: Serbia, the conflicted EU candidate
items.description: On paper, Belgrade has pursued EU membership for years. But accession has long been stalled. The hero's farewell given to war criminal Mladic exposed just how far Serbia has alienated itself from Europe.

items.title: Europe's royalty pay respects to King Harald V in Norway
items.description: The Prince of Wales and three Nordic kings were among those who attended proceedings on Wednesday.

items.title: Europe needs to compete in spaceflight, says France's Macron
items.description: The French president called for setting goals like European cargo missions, lunar landings, and crewed spaceflight while urging the bloc to reduce its reliance on US and Russia.

items.title: Uganda: Traditional kingdom plunged into succession crisis
items.description: A royal succession committee and the family of late King Oyo Nyimba of Toroo have put forward competing candidates. Questions have been raised as to whether the late monarch indeed had a son as his family claims.
